metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity
metas.description: An elite girls' school resides next to a boys' school for delinquents. One day, two students from each school, Kaoruko and Rintaro, meet and develop a connection.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2026 · Scrubs
metas.description: JD and Turk scrub in together after a long break. Medicine and interns have evolved, but their friendship remains strong. New and familiar faces at Sacred Heart bring laughs, emotion, and unexpected moments.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · The Studio
metas.description: Follows a legacy Hollywood movie studio striving to survive in a world where it is increasingly difficult for art and business to live together.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Ekaki
metas.description: A group of friends plan a fun weekend getaway to the mysterious Ekaki Villa, only to find themselves caught between laughter and fear when strange haunting begin. Filled with hilarious chaos, spooky twists, and emotional moments

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · Boots
metas.description: Bullied gay teen Cameron joins the Marine Corps with his best friend despite risks. In boot camp they experience profound personal change amid danger, as their platoon confronts both literal and figurative landmines.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Can This Love Be Translated?
metas.description: A man with a job interpreting other languages meets a woman who speaks love in a completely opposite way to him, but they understand each other.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · The Residence
metas.description: Inside the White House's staff residence and the lives which workers share with the First Family.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Pritam Pedro
metas.description: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Overcompensating
metas.description: Benny, a football player, struggles to accept his sexuality in college, finding himself overcompensating as he tries to appear as something he is not.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Adults
metas.description: A twenty-something ensemble comedy centering on codependent housemates navigating adulthood together despite their flaws.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Haunted Hotel
metas.description: A single mom with two kids operates a haunted hotel, aided by her late brother's ghost who believes they can have ingenious ideas despite his ethereal state.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Rooster
metas.description: A comedy revolving around an author's intricate bond with his daughter, set against the backdrop of a college campus.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Chad Powers
metas.description: A disgraced college quarterback named Russ Holliday disguises himself as Chad Powers and walks onto a struggling southern football team to revive his football career.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · The Ba***ds of Bollywood
metas.description: An entertaining ride through the adventures of an ambitious outsider navigating the glitzy yet tricky world of Bollywood, with self-aware humor, cameos, and larger-than-life characters for a tongue-in-cheek take on Indian cinema.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Ride or Die
metas.description: Two best friends, Judith and Debbie, discover Judith is secretly an assassin. After a hit goes wrong, they go on the run while being targeted by a mysterious enemy, forcing them to confront the secrets between them.
